title: Extend the D33 decision record: replan's cadence now includes requeueBlocked, reachable from edges and the close-out gate
body: D33's prose says the local host re-derives the plan 'only when an attempt closes', but since 3h0 requeueBlocked also calls replan when a dispatch proves the plan stale — and this attempt made that reachable from the close-out's own open-children gate. The anchored region and parity tests are untouched and green; a later tick touching D33 should extend the record rather than re-deriving the cadence.
